mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET available_stock=available_stock-1,reserved_stock=reserved_stock+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{campaignId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND start_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND end_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND available_stock>0
UPDATE campaigns SET reserved_stock=reserved_stock-1,issued_stock=issued_stock+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{campaignId} AND reserved_stock>0
UPDATE campaigns SET reserved_stock=reserved_stock-1,available_stock=available_stock+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{campaignId} AND reserved_stock>0
mapper.select: SELECT status,start_at,end_at,available_stock,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM campaigns WHERE id=#{campaignId}
